definitions.gloss: complimentary ticket; invitation ticket; free pass
definitions.explanation: A ticket given free of charge, typically for events, exhibitions, movies, or shows. Often distributed for promotional purposes or to invited guests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待券|しょうたいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a complimentary movie ticket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待券|しょうたいけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have two complimentary tickets to the art museum.

examples.japanese: {懸賞|けんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧、⟦テーマパーク→テーマパーク：28062_teemapaaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待券|しょうたいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I won a prize and got complimentary theme park tickets, so we decided to go as a family.

notes:
A free ticket given as an invitation or promotional giveaway. Composed of ⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧ (invitation) + ⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (ticket/voucher).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {招待券|しょうたいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a complimentary ticket
- {招待券|しょうたいけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧: to distribute invitation tickets
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待券|しょうたいけん}: complimentary movie ticket
- ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{招待券|しょうたいけん}: exhibition invitation ticket

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無料券|むりょうけん}→無料券：30139_muryouken⟧: free ticket/coupon — general term for any free pass
- ⟦{優待券|ゆうたいけん}→優待券：23292_yuutaiken⟧: discount/preferential ticket — offered to shareholders or members at reduced prices
- ⟦{入場券|にゅうじょうけん}→入場券：19454_nyuujouken⟧: admission ticket — a paid ticket for entry
- ⟦{招待状|しょうたいじょう}→招待状：14769_shoutaijou⟧: invitation letter/card — a written invitation, not a ticket

USAGE:
In Japan, {招待券|しょうたいけん} are commonly given away through magazine sweepstakes, promotional campaigns, corporate events, or as perks at workplaces.
